definitions.closeAndC4: Truthy locate.close/locate.c4 fields count ended calls only; close/below phase markers also checked across terminated calls.
definitions.rescue: Canonical begin(kind=rate) in phase rescue = started; p tuple[0]=rescue = completed. Tail phase rerate is counted separately.
definitions.counter: end.rerates counts attempted rerates and can exceed completed profiles by one when P5 stops before begin; this is reported, not counted as completed work.
definitions.legacy: Master on fr-frozen and every log-link request use the legacy path. W=null means canonical, not missing W; priorCount=null is expected. They do not test v4 table/per-set priors.
definitions.prior: Table = clamp(round(share*K),1,K-2). Matching Hell 1 batch calibration overrides it with clamp(wc,1,K-2), traced through the winning set and dispatch.
definitions.limitation: Row runs do not persist made records/packs; this is request-to-worker transport, not stored-recipe/replay proof. Reach is not causal speed attribution.
